name: Green Gable Contracting
comment: Green Gable Contracting is an agricultural building contractor that builds poultry houses, such as a layer house near Sheldon, Iowa, and designs them turnkey. It does not show evidence of making or selling doors or windows for other companies.

name: Henning Companies
comment: Henning Companies is a general contractor and design-builder that builds poultry layer facilities, hatcheries, and production buildings for agricultural clients. It does not appear to make or sell doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Superior Poultry Supply
comment: Builds new poultry houses and upgrades existing ones from the pad up, and is an authorized Chore-Time dealer. Also stocks and sells Chore-Time equipment and parts, including tunnel doors from another maker, and services what it installs.

name: Tidwell Construction
comment: Builds poultry houses to owners' specifications and also sells materials and material packages for them. No evidence it makes or resells doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: G & M Sales of Eastern NC Inc
comment: G & M Sales of Eastern NC is a full line stocking distributor of agricultural and construction equipment and supplies, and it builds poultry houses on site through its Johnson Murphy Construction arm, recently finishing a four-house broiler operation with Chore-Time equipment. It does not show any doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: SK Construction
comment: SK Construction is a general contractor that builds commercial poultry houses, including pullet, layer, broiler, and turkey houses, across the Northeastern US. It does not appear to make or sell doors or windows for poultry houses to other companies.

name: GPC Poultry Supply and Hardware
comment: A local hardware store and lumber yard in Carnesville, GA, that grew out of poultry farming supplies and sells feed, fencing, and poultry supplies to farmers. It does not build or sell poultry houses or doors and windows for them.

name: Farmer Boy
comment: An online distributor of agricultural supplies for poultry and other farms, selling broiler drinkers, feeders, and building materials. Also stocks Cumberland tunnel and roll seal doors made by other companies.

name: Smith Poultry Supply
comment: Smith Poultry Supply is a poultry equipment dealer with three stores in North Alabama that stocks and services parts and equipment for growers' houses. It also resells Eagan Manufacturing doors and windows for poultry houses made by another company.

name: Summit Livestock Facilities
comment: Designs and builds agricultural production facilities, which the homepage says include poultry-related livestock buildings, as a contractor. It does not show making or selling doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Hometown Poultry Supply
comment: Hometown Poultry Supply, Inc. appears to be a poultry supply business serving commercial poultry houses, based in Nashville, Arkansas, and it is hiring service technicians for poultry house equipment. The evidence does not show it making or selling doors or windows.

name: Bower Ag
comment: Bower Ag designs and builds poultry complexes, including layer and cage-free barns, pullet barns, and egg-handling centers, as a design/build firm. It does not show evidence of making or selling doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Poultry Equipment Plus
comment: A full-line poultry equipment distributor in the Southeast US that sells parts and equipment for chicken and turkey farms, and also installs equipment and provides onsite farm assistance. It does not show doors or windows, and it does not appear to build poultry houses.

name: Goodman Classic
comment: Goodman Classic constructs agricultural buildings, including poultry houses, and also sells poultry equipment such as Chore-Time fans, feeders, and heaters. It also stocks Chore-Time tunnel doors for poultry houses, which it resells from another maker.

name: Tri State Poultry Supply
comment: A locally owned supplier serving poultry farms in Alabama, Georgia, and Tennessee, selling production equipment, replacement parts, and health products. Also offers installation and retrofitting crews for poultry houses.

name: A1 Ag Services
comment: A1 Ag Services is an ag services provider in Ohio and Indiana that sells poultry-related agricultural products and offers installation and maintenance services. It is a supply reseller for poultry houses, with no evidence it makes or resells doors, windows, or whole houses.

name: Northeast Agri Systems
comment: Builds turnkey poultry houses, such as a pullet house for the Martins, and is an authorized independent distributor of Chore-Time equipment and parts. Its sold door-related items are Chore-Time or other makers' products, so it does not make doors or windows for others.

name: Premiere Poultry Supply
comment: A family-run firm in Arkansas that builds poultry houses with trusted partners and supplies, installs, and services equipment and replacement parts for growers. Also sells animal health products for poultry and cattle.

name: Midwest Livestock Systems
comment: Midwest Livestock is a dealer and service provider that sells poultry barn equipment made by other companies, such as fan belts, manure drive parts, and air chutes, plus installation and maintenance for poultry houses. It does not appear to make doors or windows or to sell finished poultry houses.

name: Kingston Construction Poultry Equipment
comment: Kingston Construction Equipment is a locally owned company that builds new poultry houses and renovates existing ones, with locations in Delmar and Pocomoke, Maryland. It also sells parts and equipment from other manufacturers through its parts request service.

name: H3co
comment: H3co, formerly Hostetler's, builds poultry buildings, including new poultry farms, and its Hostetler Buildings LLC arm handles building work. It also runs retail Hostetler Poultry Supplies stores that sell poultry equipment and supplies made by other companies.

name: 3 Nails AG Construction
comment: A Minnesota agricultural construction firm that designs, builds, and renovates livestock facilities, including poultry buildings, on a turnkey basis. It does not show any sale of doors or windows to other companies.

name: Ridgeline Builders
comment: Ridgeline Builders is a general contractor that builds broiler houses for poultry producers, such as multi-year projects in Minnesota and Wisconsin. It also builds cattle barns and warehouses, and its evidence shows no door or window products.

name: Parrish Equipment
comment: Parrish Equipment is a family-owned poultry equipment supplier in Nashville, Arkansas, that builds broiler and breeder houses and retrofits. It also supplies poultry equipment to farms in southwest Arkansas.

name: AG Building Solutions
comment: A steel building designer and general contractor that designs and builds cage-free poultry facilities, including multi-tier cage-free houses with tunnel ventilation. It also builds manure storage and food processing buildings, and does not make or sell doors or windows.

name: Midsouth Cage Equipment
comment: Based in Royston, GA, Midsouth Cage Equipment builds and equips poultry houses and supplies trusses, and says it has built hundreds of farms. It is also the largest Chore-Time distributor in Georgia, reselling that maker's poultry equipment.

name: R&R Christo Construction
comment: R&R Christo Construction is an agricultural builder that constructs poultry houses, including broiler, pullet, and layer houses, for farm clients nationwide. It does not appear to make or sell doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Premier Ag Supply
comment: Builds turnkey cage-free poultry houses on site in Western Kentucky and Tennessee, and also resells poultry house fans, motors, feeding and watering systems, and other supplies. No evidence it makes or sells doors or windows.

name: Michiana Equipment LLC
comment: Designs, builds, and installs hog and poultry barns in Indiana and Michigan, including broiler and layer barns. Also sells and services poultry equipment and parts from other makers such as Big Dutchman and Munters.

name: Lionheart Construction LLC
comment: Lionheart Construction is a contractor that builds commercial poultry houses in Georgia and South Carolina, using its own crews and equipment. It does not show any sale of doors or windows to other companies.

name: R&L Construction
comment: R&L Construction is a Virginia builder that specializes in agricultural construction, including poultry houses. It does not appear to make or resell doors or windows, and its listed activities are construction and concrete pumping.

name: Heritage Poultry LLC
comment: Heritage Poultry LLC appears to be a Warren, Arkansas outfit tied to chicken house construction and service, based on a LinkedIn listing for its owner. The evidence does not show it making or reselling doors or windows, so it is a possible supply and construction contact rather than a door or window seller.

name: Grand View Construction
comment: Grand View Construction is an agricultural and residential contractor in Harrisonburg, Virginia that builds poultry houses on site for growers. It also builds pole barns, garages, and decks, and does not appear to make or sell doors or windows to others.

name: Ozark Ag
comment: Builds and services poultry houses, including structures for poultry farmers across several southern states. Also sells poultry equipment and supplies such as feeders, lights, fans and waterlines made by other companies.

name: Georgia Poultry Equipment Co.
comment: Georgia Poultry Equipment is a construction partner tied to Hog Slat that builds turnkey poultry production units and sells equipment packages for customers who build their own facilities. It appears to resell poultry equipment and supplies made by other companies, but no doors or windows evidence was found.

name: Potters Poultry
comment: Potters Poultry makes and supplies equipment for poultry houses, including aviary systems, nests, and feeders, but none of it is doors or windows. Its manufactured equipment is not a door or window product, so it is not a fit for our doors and windows.

name: Settje Agri-Services and Engineering
comment: Settje designs, engineers, and builds livestock facilities, including poultry barns, and offers turnkey construction for them. It also provides manure management and permitting services for producers.

name: Energy Panel Structures
comment: Energy Panel Structures makes insulated panels and building packages, and offers poultry barn designs built through its network of authorized builder dealers. Its door and window work is not shown for poultry houses, so it is best approached as a poultry house package supplier.

name: Central Confinement Service LLC
comment: Designs and builds turnkey poultry barns as a design-build contractor for livestock facilities. No evidence it makes or resells doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Farmers Poultry Supply Inc.
comment: A small family-owned Cullman, Alabama company that builds and equips commercial poultry houses across the Southeast. Also resells other makers' tunnel doors, such as Reeves Supply, along with fans, feeding and ventilation equipment.

name: Heartland Builders
comment: Heartland Builders is a construction firm that builds agricultural facilities, including poultry and egg production barns, along with swine, dairy, and cattle buildings. It does not appear to sell doors or windows to others.

name: Poultry & Livestock Supply (PALS)
comment: PALS is a supplier of poultry house equipment and supplies, selling fans, controls, and fog systems made by other manufacturers to growers. It serves poultry barn customers through its Willmar sales team but does not appear to make or resell doors or windows.

name: Marydel Ag Supply
comment: A family-owned ag supply store in Marydel, DE that sells poultry supplies, parts, and equipment and provides service and installation for broiler operations. It is an authorized VALCO dealer and carries replacement parts for poultry and hog operations.

name: Penner Farm Services
comment: Penner Farm Services offers design-build services for poultry barns, handling layout, permitting, construction and startup, plus equipment installation and service. It also runs Horizon Livestock & Poultry Supply, which sells poultry farm consumables made by other companies.

name: Borders Poultry Supply
comment: A farm and poultry supply retailer with stores in East Texas and Western Louisiana that carries trusted brands of poultry house equipment and supplies for growers. It does not appear to make or resell doors, windows, or finished poultry houses.

name: Pilchuck Construction
comment: A Western Washington general contractor that builds agricultural structures, including poultry houses, alongside steel buildings and commercial work. It does not appear to make or sell doors or windows for poultry houses.

name: Zeiset Equipment
comment: Zeiset Equipment is a supplier with three locations in Pennsylvania and West Virginia that resells poultry house equipment such as feeders, watering systems, ventilation, and lighting made by other companies. It also resells Eagan tunnel doors and their parts made by other companies, and offers turn-key construction and installation services.

name: Diversified Agriculture
comment: Diversified Agriculture sells poultry house equipment such as controllers, watering, feeding, and heating systems to producers nationwide, including brands it distributes from other makers like Plasson and Rotem. It also makes and sells its own FRP tunnel doors for poultry houses.

name: VAL-CO
comment: Makes and sells its own tunnel inlet doors for poultry houses, along with ventilation, cooling, and other house equipment, through authorized dealers. It does not build poultry houses or resell other makers' products.

name: Cannonball
comment: Cannonball, a building product supplier, sells its own special use entry doors, including the 1822 door, which is offered in steel, aluminum and fiberglass for poultry houses. It also sells a range of other entry doors and building products across agriculture, commercial and metal structure markets.

name: Creative Panel Solutions
comment: Makes laminated panels and commercial and agricultural doors with FRP and HDPE facings, which fit the poultry house door category. The site does not name poultry houses, so confirm the ag doors are sold for them before pitching.

name: Pocahontas Aluminum Company
comment: Pocahontas Aluminum manufactures aluminum-framed doors and windows and sells them through building material distributors, including doors for poultry houses. It does not build the poultry houses themselves or resell other makers' products.

name: Van Acht Windows and Doors Montana
comment: Makes aluminum-framed doors, including barn bi-fold doors, for poultry houses and installs them. Its listings show barn bi-fold door installations, but no evidence of building whole poultry houses.

name: Climate Control & Air Treatment
comment: Designs and sells its own ventilation equipment for poultry houses, including tunnel doors, wall inlets, and circulation fans. Also sells fans, cooling systems, and other climate control products for broiler and layer houses.

name: East Iowa Plastics
comment: East Iowa Plastics makes the PAKSTER ventilation doors (ceiling and sidewall air inlets) for poultry houses and sells them to builders and farms. It does not build the houses themselves.

name: Ag Ventilation
comment: Ag Ventilation makes tunnel shutters and tunnel doors, along with inlet vents and door drive systems, for poultry and livestock houses. It sells these to other companies, and its strap ratcheting door operating system can also be fitted to other makers' tunnel doors.

name: Big Dutchman
comment: Designs and manufactures poultry housing equipment, including its own tunnel doors for large air inlets sold to other companies. Also makes climate, lighting, heating, and feeding equipment for poultry and egg houses.

name: QC Supply
comment: QC Supply in Collins, MS is a farm supply store serving poultry producers, stocking poultry equipment and supplies made by other companies. Its evidence does not show it selling its own doors or windows, though it is listed as a dealer for poultry house products from several makers.

name: FarmTek
comment: FarmTek is an online farm and poultry supply retailer that resells poultry house supplies made by other companies, including poultry barn curtains and accessories. It also stocks roll-up and clear vinyl doors that fit poultry and livestock buildings, but it does not make these doors itself.

name: R Supply
comment: R Supply is an online and catalog distributor of poultry house parts and supplies, an L.B. White brand. It resells tunnel door gaskets and ratchet handles for poultry houses made by other companies, plus fans, motors, pumps, and cooling parts.

name: Apple Outdoor Supply
comment: Supplies roll-up doors and vinyl windows, which appear to be made by others, along with door hardware and fasteners for outdoor buildings. It does not appear to build or sell whole poultry houses, and its poultry-house link is not explicitly stated on its site.

name: Hog Slat
comment: Hog Slat is a known participant in the commercial poultry house market, listed as a manufacturer of poultry houses. The only evidence available is a page about it opening a new store in North Carolina, which does not show specific poultry house or door activities.

name: Automated Production Systems
comment: Automated Production (AP), a brand of Grain & Protein Technologies, is known in this market for its own products, not for building or reselling poultry houses. The evidence shows its outside tunnel doors and related ventilation gear, and the company's pages focus on swine and poultry climate control, feeding, and controls.

name: MSI (Martin Structures Inc.)
comment: MSI is a Mennonite-owned custom builder in central Missouri that builds barndominiums, garages, and agricultural buildings, including horse and poultry barns. It does not show evidence of building commercial poultry houses or of making or reselling tunnel or other poultry doors and windows.

name: Jones Building Systems
comment: Jones Building Systems is a licensed general contractor in Northwest Arkansas that builds metal buildings, including agricultural and livestock buildings, and says it can ask about poultry house construction. It does not appear to make or sell doors or windows for poultry houses, and its site does not show that it builds poultry houses.

name: Aloha Truss
comment: Aloha Truss designs and manufactures wood roof trusses from its Ramona, California facility, and it has mentioned building trusses for poultry houses among agricultural jobs. It does not appear to make doors or windows, or to resell other companies' products for poultry houses.

name: Facco USA Inc.
comment: Facco USA makes its own poultry egg collection equipment, including the Niagara system, and its listing shows no doors, windows, or whole poultry houses. It does not appear to resell other makers' products.

name: BORGA
comment: BORGA is a California steel building company whose agriculture buildings are said to serve poultry farming among other sectors. Its site shows steel buildings and panel and trim components, but no poultry houses or poultry doors or windows.

name: Bifold Doors (Schweiss Doors)
comment: Schweiss Doors makes hydraulic and bifold doors for aircraft hangars, agricultural buildings, and other structures, with no evidence it builds or sells doors specifically for commercial poultry houses. Its poultry-related pages are customer inquiries rather than product offerings for poultry houses, so it appears to be a door maker serving the poultry market only peripherally.
